source: Rate Cycle & Exit Timing — Scenario Cohort (operator report, August 2026; PDF aef819cd-Rate_Cycle_Scenario_Cohort.pdf). Basis per report: CME FedWatch futures pricing (Jul 2026); Jun 2026 FOMC SEP & minutes; Jul 29 2026 FOMC statement (9-3 hold, three hawkish dissents); Sept-Dec 2016 dissent precedent; 1994/1999-2000/2004-08/2022 cycle history; 2022-23 middle-market multiple data; company financials per management.

deal_profile.ebitda: double-digit (not stated numerically; report implies ~10-13x EBITDA at $200M, i.e. ~$15-20M EBITDA — NOT the 14.0 used by the seed)
deal_profile.pricing_basis: REVENUE multiple (~1.9x on $105M revenue). Report stresses revenue-multiple pricing is longer-duration and MORE rate-sensitive than mature EBITDA pricing; downside cells are widened accordingly.
deal_profile.transmission_lag: Rate hikes hit private-market valuations with a 1-2 quarter lag; Q4 2026 hikes land on private deal pricing in Q1-Q2 2027 (the target close window).

close_window_note: The report's month/quarter dimension is exactly two close dates (end Q1 '27, end Q2 '27) — no monthly axis. Any monthly surface must interpolate/extrapolate beyond the report.

aggregates.modal_outcome: 1 hike (Oct), hold in Dec, close end Q1 2027 at $192-200M (~35%)
aggregates.hike3_regime_break: Beyond two hikes buyer behavior shifts categorically: ICs pause, financing gets outs, LOIs get retraded; ~25-35% odds the process stalls entirely in the 3-4 hike rows.
aggregates.increment_assumption: All scenarios assume 25bp increments (the priced, telegraphed path).
aggregates.regime_change_50bp: A shift to 50bp increments (Fed behind the curve) is a regime change: values gap toward $145-170M and process completion itself is at risk.

mechanisms.debt_capacity: Dominant channel. Lenders size to coverage ratios: each ~50bp cuts ~a quarter-turn of leverage ~= $10M less buyer debt, straight out of price.
mechanisms.revenue_multiple_duration: 2022-23 precedent: revenue-priced deals compressed 60%+ peak-to-trough vs ~20% for mature EBITDA deals; at ~1.9x revenue this deal carries the longer-duration sensitivity (wider downside cells).
mechanisms.two_speed_2026: Speed one (immediate): 2022-style equity duration at 1999-style valuations — hawkish surprises transmit same-day but are small (50-100bp, two-thirds priced): 3-7% air pockets, not a cascade. Speed two (lagged): real leverage sits in AI capex commitments and private credit (2000-style topology); if tightening cracks that, damage arrives 2-4 quarters later (mid-to-late 2027, after target close). Strongest structural argument for Q1 over Q2 close.

rate_path_context.futures: First 25bp hike priced late October; ~65-70% odds of at least one hike by December; coin-flip on a second in December.
rate_path_context.dissent_cluster: Jul 29 2026 hold passed 9-3; Hammack, Kashkari, Logan dissented for an immediate hike — first unified three-way directional dissent since September 2016 (which was followed by a hike that December). Fed historically moves in the dissent direction within 1-2 meetings.
rate_path_context.dot_plot: Jun 2026 median end-2026 rate jumped 3.4% -> 3.8%; 9 of 19 officials projected at least one hike.
rate_path_context.catalysts: September CPI and Sept 16 dot plot reveal the path before October; further hawkish dot migration or a fourth dissenter => accelerate hard.

recommended_posture: Move left: LOI with committed financing before the December FOMC locks today's terms, neutralizes most cohort downside, and front-runs the lagged transmission channel.
Watch September CPI and the Sept 16 dot plot.

comparison_to_seeded_surface.seed_reference: treasury-canary/backend/app/ewm/core.py PARAMS: multiples [14.5, 14.0, 13.4, 11.8, 11.2] x EBITDA 14.0 => point values [203.0, 196.0, 187.6, 165.2, 156.8]; weights [0.30, 0.35, 0.25, 0.07, 0.03]; weighted EV 192.7 at Q1'27 anchor.
agreements: Scenario probabilities MATCH exactly: report ~30/35/25/7/3 vs seed [0.30, 0.35, 0.25, 0.07, 0.03].
Five cumulative-hike scenarios (0-4), 25bp increments — same scenario set.
Modal outcome MATCHES: seed modal 196 at Q1'27 sits inside the report's modal cell $192-200M (1 hike, Q1 close); report midpoint 196 equals the seed exactly for scenario 1.

Hike-3 cliff present in both: seed drops 1.6 turns (187.6 -> 165.2, -22.4M); report drops ~19M at midpoints (180 -> 161) AND adds an explicit 25-35% process-stall probability the seed handles separately via DMHI stall modeling.
Month-axis direction matches amendment A5's asymmetric shape: report dove rows GAIN Q1->Q2 (s0 +5M, s1 +2M at midpoints) while hawk rows LOSE (s3 -6M, s4 -7M).
disagreements: PRICING BASIS: report prices on REVENUE multiples (1.38-2.00x on $105M revenue) and states the implied EBITDA multiple is only 10-13x; the seed uses 14.0-14.5x EBITDA multiples on EBITDA 14.0. Same dollar values, different basis — the seed's EBITDA-multiple framing (and the spec's +$1M EBITDA ~ +$13-15M rule) overstates the report's implied EBITDA multiple and understates its implied EBITDA (~$15-20M).

LEVEL SKEW: seed scenario values sit ABOVE report midpoints for hawk scenarios — s2: 187.6 vs midpoint 180 (+7.6M, seed near the top of the report's widest range 170-190); s3: 165.2 vs 161 (+4.2M); s4: 156.8 vs 153.5 (+3.3M). Seed weighted EV 192.7 sits at the very top of the report's ~$186-193M band; report midpoints give ~191.0.

RANGES vs POINTS: the report gives per-scenario value RANGES (width $8-22M, widest in hawk rows per the revenue-duration argument); the seed collapses these to points and layers a flat 6% exec-noise band (exec_noise_pct), which does not reproduce the report's hawk-skewed widening.

MONTH AXIS MAGNITUDE: seed shape terms are -0.15x/q hawk (-2.1M/q) and +0.10x/q dove (+1.4M/q, s0 only, s1/s2 flat); the report's Q1->Q2 midpoint moves are roughly 3x larger and hit ALL rows: s0 +5M, s1 +2M, s2 -3.5M, s3 -6M, s4 -7M. Notably the seed treats scenario 2 as flat while the report has it declining into Q2.

MISSING IN SEED: fed-funds range per scenario; explicit 25-35% stall odds attached to rows 3-4; the 50bp-increment regime-change branch (values gap to $145-170M) — the seed has no out-of-cohort regime branch; the ~$10M-per-50bp debt-capacity anchor.
WEIGHTED EV BAND: report states ~$186-193M vs spec G1 gate 189-194M — overlapping but not identical; the report's band extends 3M lower.
comparison_to_seeded_surface.wiring_notes: When replacing the seed: keep weights as-is; take per-scenario Q1/Q2 value ranges as the authoritative V(s,m) at the two report close windows (midpoints as central, range as scenario band replacing flat exec noise); refit the monthly shape so Q1'27-end and Q2'27-end reproduce the report cells (hawk decay ~3x current, s1/s2 no longer flat); carry the 25-35% row-level stall probability into the DMHI stall layer rather than into V; add the 50bp regime-change branch as a flagged off-cohort stress case, not a sixth weighted scenario.
